arguments.text: 8000 m, 1250 m out-and-back legs (~42 min). Start was hot (pod 250 W vs CP 185). Plan: settle to about pod CP + 5 W (~190 W shaft) from minute 2, even effort, keep pod reserve above ~35 % until 1.5 km to go, then spend it (push at 1500 m, finish at 400 m). Check the CP calibration with heart rate: HR should level off at a steady effort below CP and keep climbing above it. Watch for drag changes (weed: push_local drops on both directions), pod drift (pod vs GPS share changes), radio course changes. Turns flip current and wind.
